answer.text: In January 2026, AU-WEST had by far the highest P1 SLA breach rate at 80.0%. NZ-SOUTH was next at 14.29%, then AU-EAST at 10.53% and NZ-NORTH at 5.88%.
assumptions: Breach rate = percentage of P1 tickets that breached their resolution SLA

sql.sql:
select t.region as region, round(100.0 * avg(t.is_sla_breached::int), 2) as sla_breach_rate
from marts.fct_tickets as t
where t.opened_date between %(start_date)s and %(end_date)s and t.priority = any(%(filter_0)s)
group by 1
order by 2 desc nulls last
limit %(row_limit)s
